Hanno Eco-Tourism Association: https://hanno-tourism.jp/hanno-eco/tour/ec-tyokottotenranzan-akihuyu/

Walk with a guide and discover subtle changes in nature that you might miss on an ordinary stroll.

【Fee】
¥2,000 per person; ¥1,500 for returning visitors; ¥4,000 per family (includes guide fee, insurance, etc.)

【Capacity】
10 people

【Guide】
Koji Kojima (Wildlife Section)

【What to bring】
• Drinking water
• Rain gear
• Backpack or similar (hands-free bag recommended)
• Towel
• Insect repellent supplies
location: 集合 飯能市立博物館前（国際興業バス「OH!!!・天覧山下」または「市民会館・博物館」バス停下車徒歩3分）
